Krabi

Stay in Ao Nang for convenience or Railay if you accept the boat-only beach. The cliffs are the point.

Ao NangRailayKBV
SeasonBest November to April
AirportKBV, or transfer from HKT
BoatsRailay longtail; Phi Phi ferry

Ao Nang is the logistics town. Railay is a pocket beach with no road. Phi Phi is a day trip or a night if you want the village after the boats leave.

Rayavadee sits in the Railay-Phra Nang pocket and is filed under resort living.

Common questions

Phuket or Krabi?
Krabi if the cliffs matter. Phuket if the flight times and resort row matter. You can boat between them in a morning in season.
